verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management platform, so letting an agent draft option grants programmatically and queue them for board approval is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no programmatic surface for this: OpenAPI probes all returned 404, llms.txt is only a descriptive summary, and the docs describe grants and board governance through the web UI only. The HRIS integration is an adjacent data-sync feature and does not let an agent draft securities.
